source.section: X.A.6 (printed p43); Senior thresholds X.A.1.g(1)-(4) (printed p42)
source.quote_free_summary: A couple's classification uses the older partner's age for Pre-Teen I through Youth and Adult, and the younger partner's age for the Senior classes; Senior I-IV also need two partner thresholds (35/30, 45/40, 55/50, 65/60).

requirement: Competition OS does not compute couple age. The NDCA amateur age_basis would carry subject_rule older_partner for the lower classes and both_partners_thresholds for Senior.
enforcement_point: Not built. Design only (docs/competition/governance/editions/OD-30-rulebook-editions-design.md). The OD-03/OD-18 organizer determination is the only age-division control at first activation.
interpretation_notes: EFFECTIVE DATE UNKNOWN: effective_from is a schema-required PLACEHOLDER (the date the governance registry was introduced), NOT a verified effective date; no pinned source states one (OD-30 finding F-1).
